candidates.description: Read the saved configuration after the update.
Check that the saved JSON matches the observed configuration with only north workers changed.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
expected = {'services': {'east': {'workers': 1, 'timeout': 30, 'enabled': True}, 'west': {'workers': 3, 'timeout': 30, 'enabled': True}, 'north': {'workers': 8, 'timeout': 30, 'enabled': True}}, 'revision': 101}
actual = json.loads(Path('/app/data/services.json').read_text())
assert actual == expected, 'Saved configuration differs from the expected values'
print('Saved JSON matches the expected values.')
PY
